headline: Executive order creates a White House Millennium Council, apparently tied to marking the year 2000.
what_it_does: This order sets up a group inside the White House called the Millennium Council. Only the title was provided, so the council's exact members, duties, and powers are not described here. The name suggests it was meant to plan or coordinate activities around the start of the new millennium.
when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 2, 1998; the source does not give a separate start date.
